desc.zh: 让相邻密码重叠，用每条边一次构造最短开锁串。
desc.en: Overlap passwords and use each edge once to build a shortest unlocking string.

complexity: O(k^n + n) time; O(k^n + n) space including output

concepts.name: Password overlap graph
concepts.description: Encode length-n passwords as edges between length-(n-1) suffixes.

concepts.name: Iterative Euler circuit
concepts.description: Consume each password edge once and reverse incoming digits at finishing time.
